tests.name: Contract validation
tests.pass_condition: Missing or unknown fields fail with a named validation error.

tests.name: Generic core
tests.pass_condition: Both domain packs execute through the same core commit without a domain-name branch.

tests.name: Material-free start
tests.pass_condition: MOCK mode completes upload stub, analysis, question, approval, execution and scoring offline.

tests.name: Real multimodal input
tests.pass_condition: An original short video and a text document produce verifiable source references through Gemini.

tests.name: Evidence integrity
tests.pass_condition: Unknown source IDs or out-of-range locators cannot become approved evidence.

tests.name: Unknown values
tests.pass_condition: A missing fact produces HOLD rather than an invented default or comparison result.

tests.name: Human approval
tests.pass_condition: A DRAFT teaching event cannot change the active rule version.

tests.name: Version conflict
tests.pass_condition: Approval against an outdated version returns 409 without overwriting another change.

tests.name: Conflicting rules
tests.pass_condition: Equal-priority contradictory matching rules produce HOLD and a conflict record.

tests.name: Actual execution
tests.pass_condition: A successful action changes the isolated case state and creates a receipt.

tests.name: Idempotency
tests.pass_condition: A repeated request ID returns the original result and does not repeat a state change.

tests.name: Recovery
tests.pass_condition: Interrupted model calls and expired leases can be resumed without duplicate application.

tests.name: Reproducible replay
tests.pass_condition: Each arm starts from an independent copy of the same initial state.

tests.name: Holdout isolation
tests.pass_condition: Expected labels, reference v1 rules and holdout traces are absent from teaching and solver prompts.

tests.name: Honest comparison
tests.pass_condition: A B C arms use the same model, frozen cases and call limits; all failures remain in the denominator.

tests.name: Measured improvement
tests.pass_condition: Report actual completion, error and human-input results, not target values or fabricated gains.

tests.name: No critical sample errors
tests.pass_condition: No disallowed execution on mandatory-hold cases in the final benchmark sample.

tests.name: Cross-session isolation
tests.pass_condition: A session cannot read or mutate another session by guessing object IDs.

tests.name: Input safety
tests.pass_condition: Oversized, invalid and instruction-injection files are rejected or treated only as evidence.

tests.name: Server-side secrets
tests.pass_condition: No cloud credentials, admin secret or private source content appear in frontend bundles or public logs.

tests.name: Cost limit
tests.pass_condition: An exhausted request budget prevents a new model call; it never falls back to an unlabeled fake result.

tests.name: Reviewer experience
tests.pass_condition: A fresh browser can complete the main guided demo; 429 and provider failure have understandable messages.

tests.name: Source changes
tests.pass_condition: A changed source hash marks dependent rules and results stale and requires re-approval before a new run.

tests.name: No live business side effects
tests.pass_condition: The prototype performs no payments, emails, access grants or writes to customer systems.

tests.name: Export consistency
tests.pass_condition: Export includes dataset and code hashes, model version, prompts, rule versions and actual usage.

tests.name: Fixture separation
tests.pass_condition: Reference labels and v1 fixture rules are for tests only and are never preloaded as LIVE learning results.

tests.name: External material swap
tests.pass_condition: A de-identified new pack can be added using the same schema without modifying the core.
